segments.source: The ColorSync Manager defines the structure [`CM2Header`](cm2header.md) to represent the profile header for the version 2.x profile format defined by the ICC.The `deviceAttributes` field of the `CM2Header` structure is an array of two unsigned long values whose bits specify information about a profile.

segments.contextAfter: The ICC reserves the use of `deviceAttributes[1]` and has assigned values to bits 0 and 1.
